arxiv-1803-02321.title: Monte Carlo Top Quark Mass Calibration
arxiv-1803-02321.creator: Bahman Dehnadi, André H. Hoang, Vicent Mateu, Iain W. Stewart
arxiv-1803-02321.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Bahman Dehnadi, André H. Hoang, Vicent Mateu, Iain W. Stewart. The most precise top quark mass measurements use kinematic reconstruction methods, determining the top mass parameter of a Monte Carlo event generator, m t MC m_{t}^{\rm MC} . Due to the complicated interplay of hadronization and parton shower dynamics in Monte Carlo event generators relevant for kinematic reconstruction, relating m t MC m_{t}^{\rm MC} to field theory masses is a non-trivial task.

arxiv-2007-08955.title: Constraint-Based Software Diversification for Efficient Mitigation of Code-Reuse Attacks
arxiv-2007-08955.creator: Rodothea Myrsini Tsoupidi, Roberto Castañeda Lozano, Benoit Baudry
arxiv-2007-08955.description: Abstract Modern software deployment process produces software that is uniform, and hence vulnerable to large-scale code-reuse attacks. Compiler-based diversification improves the resilience and security of software systems by automatically generating different assembly code versions of a given program. Existing techniques are efficient but do not have a precise control over the quality of the generated code variants.

arxiv-2107-07731.title: Improved Measurements of the Sun’s Meridional Flow and Torsional Oscillation from Correlation tracking on MDI & HMI magnetograms
arxiv-2107-07731.creator: Sushant S. Mahajan, David H. Hathaway, Andrés Muñoz-Jaramillo, Petrus C. Martens
arxiv-2107-07731.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sushant S. Mahajan, David H. Hathaway, Andrés Muñoz-Jaramillo, Petrus C. Martens. The Sun’s axisymmetric flows, differential rotation and meridional flow, govern the dynamics of the solar magnetic cycle and variety of methods are used to measure these flows, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Flow measurements based on cross-correlating images of the surface magnetic field have been made since the 1970s which require advanced numerical techniques that are capable of detecting movements of less than the pixel size in images of the Sun.

arxiv-2111-00818.title: Third order post-Newtonian gravitational radiation from two-body scattering. Instantaneous Energy and Angular momentum radiations
arxiv-2111-00818.creator: Gihyuk Cho, Subhajit Dandapat, Achamveedu Gopakumar
arxiv-2111-00818.description: Abstract We compute the third post-Newtonian (3PN) accurate instantaneous contributions to the radiated gravitational wave (GW) energy and angular momentum arising from the hyperbolic passages of non-spinning compact objects. The present computations employ 3PN-accurate instantaneous contributions to the far-zone energy and angular momentum fluxes and the 3PN-accurate Keplerian type parametric solution for compact binaries in hyperbolic orbits.

arxiv-2111-06067.title: Solving Multi-Arm Bandit Using a Few Bits of Communication
arxiv-2111-06067.creator: Osama A. Hanna † , Lin F. Yang † and Christina Fragouli † † University of California, Los Angeles Email:{ohanna, linyang, christina.fragouli}@ucla.edu
arxiv-2111-06067.description: Abstract The multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem is an active learning framework that aims to select the best among a set of actions by sequentially observing rewards. Recently, it has become popular for a number of applications over wireless networks, where communication constraints can form a bottleneck.

arxiv-2212-03684.title: A Decision Diagram Operation for Reachability
arxiv-2212-03684.creator: Sebastiaan Brand, Thomas Bäck, Alfons Laarman
arxiv-2212-03684.description: Abstract Saturation is considered the state-of-the-art method for computing fixpoints with decision diagrams. We present a relatively simple decision diagram operation called Reach that also computes fixpoints. In contrast to saturation, it does not require a partitioning of the transition relation.

arxiv-2405-04324.title: Granite Code Models: A Family of Open Foundation Models for Code Intelligence
arxiv-2405-04324.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on code are revolutionizing the software development process. Increasingly, code LLMs are being integrated into software development environments to improve the productivity of human programmers, and LLM-based agents are beginning to show promise for handling complex tasks autonomously.

arxiv-2502-14688.creator: J. D. Lyman, V. S. Dhillon, S. Kamann, A. A. Chrimes, A. J. Levan, I. Pelisoli, D. T. H. Steeghs, K. Wiersema
arxiv-2502-14688.description: Abstract GLEAM-X J1627–52 was discovered as a periodic ( ∼ \sim 18 min) radio signal over a duration of three months in 2018. It is an enigmatic example of a growing population of ‘long-period radio transients’ consistent with Galactic origins.

arxiv-2504-10897.title: SCOOP: A Quantum-Computing Framework for Constrained Combinatorial Optimization Thanks: This research was supported in part by a National Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC) of Canada Collaborative Research and Training Experience (CREATE) grant on Quantum Computing, NSERC Alliance Con
arxiv-2504-10897.creator: Prashanti Priya Angara, Emily Martins, Ulrike Stege, Hausi Müller
arxiv-2504-10897.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Prashanti Priya Angara, Emily Martins, Ulrike Stege, Hausi Müller. While the ultimate goal of solving computationally intractable problems is to find a provably optimal solutions, practical constraints of real-world scenarios often necessitate focusing on efficiently obtaining high-quality, near-optimal solutions. The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a state-of-the-art hybrid quantum-classical approach for tackling these challenging problems that are encoded using quadratic and higher-order unconstrained binary optimization problems (QUBO and HUBO). We present SCOOP, a novel QAOA-based framework for solving constrained optimization problems.

pmc-11491726.title: Regulation of cardiovascular diseases by histone deacetylases and NADPH oxidases
pmc-11491726.creator: Hui Yan, Yidan Yin, Yichen Zhou, Zhanghang Li, Yuxing Li, Lingxuan Ren, Jiazheng Wen, Weirong Wang
pmc-11491726.description: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) play critical roles in cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). In addition, reactive oxygen species (ROS) produced by NADPH oxidases (NOXs) exert damaging effects due to oxidative stress on heart and blood vessels. Although NOX-dependent ROS production is implicated in pathogenesis, the relationship between HDACs and NOXs in CVDs remains to be elucidated.

pmc-11529568.creator: Yi-Yun Chen, Pawel Borkowski, Natalia Nazarenko, Luca Biavati, Matthew Parker, Ishmum Chowdhury, Coral Vargas-Pena, Shivang Bhakta, Vibhor Garg, Joshua Bock, Robert T Faillace, Leonidas Palaiodimos
pmc-11529568.description: PurposeStudies have elucidated that heart failure (HF) in people living with HIV manifests differently when compared with HF cases in the general population. This cohort aimed to examine the mortality risk factors, including biological and social factors, as well as suitable medical interventions to prevent death in this population.

pmc-12431143.title: MECO: Mixture-of-Expert Codebooks for Multiple Dense Prediction Tasks
pmc-12431143.creator: Gyutae Hwang, Sang Jun Lee
pmc-12431143.description: Autonomous systems operating in embedded environments require robust scene understanding under computational constraints. Multi-task learning offers a compact alternative to deploying multiple task-specific models by jointly solving dense prediction tasks. However, recent MTL models often suffer from entangled shared feature representations and significant computational overhead.

pmc-12951858.creator: Seyedeh Asma Hosseini, Awat Feizi, Fatemeh Yaghoubizadeh Vanini
pmc-12951858.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the psychometric properties of the Persian version of the Health Behavior Inventory (HBI-20) among Iranian women by investigating its factor structure, internal consistency, test–retest reliability, and criterion validity.Participants and MethodsA total of 265 Iranian women completed the HBI-20. pmc-13091610.description: The colorectal cancer screening programme was fully implemented in the Community of Madrid in 2019. pmc-13449422.title: Macrophage-reprogramming calcium alginate microspheres enhance exosome-mediated antigen cross-presentation to boost embolization-immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13449422.creator: Xiaoju Guo, Shiji Fang, Liyun Zheng, Mengzhu Han, Yiming Ding, Jiale Chen, Pan Qin, Yeyu Zhang, Gaofeng Shu, Zhongwei Zhao, Xiaoqiang Li, Chenying Lu, Minjiang Chen, Jiansong Ji
pmc-13449422.description: Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a first-line therapeutic modality for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Nevertheless, its therapeutic efficacy remains constrained by the hostile tumor microenvironment (TME), typified by acidity and an immunosuppressive milieu. Here, multifunctional microspheres (RC6CaAlgMS) were developed to neutralize the acidic TME and relieve immunosuppression.

uslaw-usc-t14-s334.title: 14 U.S.C. § 334 — National Coast Guard Museum
uslaw-usc-t14-s334.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s334.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 3 (Composition And Organization); Subchapter III (Programs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment.— The Commandant may establish, accept, operate, maintain and support the Museum, on lands which will be federally owned and administered by the Coast Guard, and are located in New London, Connecticut. (b) Use of Funds.— The Secretary may expend funds.
